domain_guidance.summary: Part 1 covers core knowledge areas and introductory concepts relevant to safe quality food practitioner requirements. Candidates should study the primary compliance principles and operational guidelines specified in official Safe Quality Food Institute criteria documentation before taking the examination.

Part 2 focuses on intermediate implementation principles, program execution, and operational practices required for maintaining food safety systems. Test takers need to understand standard food handling rules and monitoring processes established by the Safe Quality Food Institute.

Part 3 addresses advanced standards, verification procedures, audit protocols, and documentation practices within the safe quality food management system. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in evaluating food safety programs in alignment with official SQFI criteria.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your pacing across the 60 questions within the allotted 60 minutes. Carefully read each question and response option before submitting your answer to achieve the required 70% passing score.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 60 questions delivered in a multiple-choice or similar format. Candidates must complete all 60 items within the allotted time without exceeding the session limits.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for the certification is 70%. Candidates must meet or exceed this 70% benchmark across all sections of the test in order to successfully earn the credential.
The exam duration is 60 minutes. Candidates should monitor their pacing throughout the session to ensure all 60 questions are answered properly before the time expires.
The certification is administered by SQFI (Safe Quality Food Institute). Candidates should check with SQFI for the current certification path and any updates to candidate criteria.

editorial.overview: The SQF Practitioner Food Safety Certification, administered by SQFI (Safe Quality Food Institute), evaluates professional competencies across 3 distinct parts. Candidates must complete 60 questions within 60 minutes to achieve the required passing score. The test evaluates knowledge across Part 1, Part 2, and Part 3 to confirm candidates reach the 70% passing threshold.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official SQFI study materials, criteria documents, and handbook guidelines before attempting the test. Focus on understanding the structure and specific requirements outlined across Part 1, Part 2, and Part 3. Practice answering items steadily to prepare for completing all 60 questions within the 60 minutes allowed to achieve the 70% score.
editorial.who_should_take: Food safety professionals, quality assurance managers, compliance officers, and plant personnel responsible for maintaining and implementing safe quality food systems within retail or food processing facilities seeking SQFI certification.
